leah: Heads-up: noticed ~1.9% of HubSpot inbound leads become owner=null during enrichment spikes. Need a short playbook to stop SLAs slipping.
omar: Can you paste sample lead IDs? Is this enrichment timeout or webhook retries?
ciara: Logs show enrichment queue backpressure; assigner waits 60s then marks unassigned. Suggest fast-path assign with fallback owner and merge enrichment later.
leah: Proposed fallback owner = `inbound-marketing-hold`. Also tag fallback leads with `fallback_reason=ENRICH_TIMEOUT`.
omar: Metrics to add: assign_p50/p95, fallback_rate, duplicate_creates. Alert if fallback_rate > 1% over 10m.
leadbot: lead-monitor: 9 unassigned >10m in last 24h.
ciara: Implementation: set enrichment_wait_ms=8000, fast_assign=true, idempotency_ttl_s=300. RR tweak: add 25s jitter and owner lease to prevent claim collisions.
leah: Runbook: toggle FF `lead.fast_assign`, watch Grafana panel (Assign latency, fallback_rate, duplicates), rollback if fallback_rate spikes.
omar: QA: simulate HS 429 in staging, verify SF create rules don't clear owner, test idempotent webhook.
ciara: I'll ship small canary patch with tests and a dead-letter backfill job.
leah: Thanks. Actions: @ciara patch+tests, @omar SF check, I'll own rollout+docs. Post canary status here. :thumbsup:
